NBA DFS Picks for Wednesday, November 18 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Wednesday, November 18 · 9 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 18, 6:18 PM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) is the top-projected player on the Wednesday, November 18 DraftKings main slate at 59.6 DraftKings points for $11,500. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 50.3, $10,400) and Cade Cunningham (DET, 49.3, $10,000) are next.

Immanuel Quickley (TOR) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.26 projected points per $1,000 at $6,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 18, 6:18 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
